note: G48: a split that cannot leak by construction, and the honest filtered MRR that comes off it. No knob, no threshold, nothing fitted to the answer.

controls.name: C1_detector_still_fires_on_the_original_split
controls.must_fire_because: the same-pair detector must still report the original split's leakage, or F1's zero is a blind detector rather than a clean split
controls.can_fail_because: the detector reporting 0 on a split G46 measured at 30%
controls.null_must_contain: a non-zero count, which is what the original split produces

observations.what_would_fail_it: the same-pair detector reporting 0 on the ORIGINAL split, which would satisfy F1 for the wrong reason -- a detector blind everywhere (A15)

controls.name: C2_test_sets_are_comparable_in_size
controls.must_fire_because: the two test sets must be comparable, or F2 compares sample sizes
controls.can_fail_because: a pair-disjoint test set far from 40,818 triples
controls.null_must_contain: an out-of-tolerance ratio, which unequal pair sizes could produce

observations.what_would_fail_it: a pair-disjoint test set far from 40,818, which would make F2 a comparison of two sample sizes

controls.name: C3_instrument_unchanged_on_the_original_split
controls.must_fire_because: the original arm must return the published figure, or this is not the instrument G34, G46 and G47 used
controls.can_fail_because: the original arm returning anything but 0.2648 / 0.3929
controls.null_must_contain: a differing figure: the literals come from G34/RESULT.md

observations.what_would_fail_it: the original arm returning anything but 0.2648 / 0.3929, which would mean this is not the instrument G34, G46 and G47 used

falsifiers.name: F1_pair_disjoint_split_still_leaks
falsifiers.can_fail_because: one or more test triples have a same-pair train edge
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a non-zero leak, which C1 shows the same detector reports
falsifiers.refutes: the instrument itself: a gate that does not gate is withdrawn
falsifiers.fires_when: one or more test triples have a same-pair train edge
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F2_leak_free_split_matches_the_headline
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the leak-free split lands within 0.002 of 0.2648
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a matching figure, which the original arm produces on this same run
falsifiers.refutes: G46's mechanism: that same-pair leakage is what carried 0.2648
falsifiers.fires_when: the leak-free split lands within 0.002 of 0.2648
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F3_train_volume_confound
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the pair-disjoint train set differs from the original by over 5%
falsifiers.null_must_contain: an out-of-tolerance ratio, which greedy group fill could produce
falsifiers.refutes: the right to read the drop as leakage rather than training volume
falsifiers.fires_when: the pair-disjoint train set differs from the original by over 5%
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: any same-pair train edge surviving in the pair-disjoint test set, which would mean the constructor does not do what it claims and the instrument is fiction
